items.title: At least 30 killed in fuel tanker fire near Cairo, Egypt’s Health Ministry says
items.brief: At least 30 people were killed and 15 others injured in a fire involving a tanker truck carrying petroleum products in Egypt’s Giza governorate on Wednesday, according to the Egyptian Ministry of Health and Population.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers goes scorched earth on Steelers and coach Mike McCarthy after being benched
items.brief: Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday launched a series of incendiary accusations toward his Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy after being benched only a few hours earlier.

items.title: Russian oil firm Lukoil’s overseas assets sold to investors led by US billionaire Todd Boehly
items.brief: US billionaire Todd Boehly is leading a consortium to acquire the vast portfolio of international energy assets belonging to Russia’s second-largest oil producer, his investment firm Eldridge announced Wednesday.

items.title: New images reveal stadium-size crater left by humanity’s first planetary defense test
items.brief: NASA’s DART spacecraft moved an asteroid called Dimorphos four years ago in humanity’s first planetary defense test — a movie-worthy mission to explore whether it’s possible to stop an asteroid from hitting Earth.

items.title: 6 relatives on a fishing trip were killed after their plane crashed near Mississippi’s Horn Island
items.brief: Six relatives from two families who were on a fishing trip together died when a small plane carrying them crashed Tuesday near Mississippi’s Horn Island , according to their families.

items.title: Cufflinks and clock stolen during break-in at country home of Prince William and wife Kate, court hears
items.brief: Two men allegedly climbed a drainpipe to break into the country residence of Britain’s Prince William and his wife Catherine, a UK court has heard.

items.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, illegally deported by the Trump administration, arrives in Spain after voluntarily leaving the US
items.brief: Kilmar Abrego Garcia , whom the Trump administration illegally deported to El Salvador last year as part of its immigration crackdown, arrived in Spain Wednesday after voluntarily leaving the US.
